reviews.shade: Purito Seoul Oat PDRN Gentle Refining Toner 200ml
reviews.text: 質地非常清爽不黏膩，上臉吸收很快，但保濕力完全足夠，整天下來肌膚都維持在很舒適的水嫩狀態。最棒的是成分非常溫和，完全不刺激，對於敏感肌和混合肌來說簡直是救星，用起來超級安心！真心推薦給在找無負擔保濕產品的朋友，一定會再回購！
reviews.zh: 質地非常清爽唔黏膩，上臉吸收好快，但係保濕力完全足夠，整日下嚟肌膚都維持喺好舒適嘅水嫩狀態。最好嘅係成分非常溫和，完全唔刺激，對於敏感肌同混合肌嚟講簡直係救星，用起嚟超級安心！真心推薦畀搵緊冇負擔保濕產品嘅朋友，一定會再回購！

reviews.shade: Purito Seoul Oat PDRN Gentle Refining Toner 200ml
reviews.text: I’ve been enjoying this toner. It’s very gentle, hydrating, and leaves my skin feeling soft and calm without any irritation. It layers well with the rest of my skincare and doesn’t feel sticky. A great option if you have sensitive or dry skin.
reviews.zh: 我一直好享受呢款化妝水。好溫和、有保濕效果，搽完皮膚感覺柔軟平靜，冇任何刺激。同我其他護膚產品疊埋一齊用都好啱，而且唔會覺得黏。如果你係敏感肌或者乾性皮膚，呢款係個好選擇。

reviews.shade: Purito Seoul Oat PDRN Gentle Refining Toner 200ml
reviews.text: Love how hydrated and comfortable my skin is after applying. I have very sensitive skin, dehydrated skin and it absolutely loves this toner
reviews.zh: 好鍾意搽完之後皮膚嘅水潤同舒適感。我嘅皮膚好敏感、缺水，我嘅皮膚好鍾意呢款化妝水。

reviews.shade: Purito Seoul Oat PDRN Gentle Refining Toner 200ml
reviews.text: love this toner over the light tirtir one! hydrates and doesn’t leave my skin oily as an oily skinned girl!
reviews.zh: 比起 tirtir 嗰款輕盈版，我更鍾意呢款化妝水！保濕效果好，而且作為油性皮膚嘅女仔，用完唔會令皮膚出油！

reviews.shade: Purito Seoul Oat PDRN Gentle Refining Toner 200ml
reviews.text: I'm in love with this toner! Absorbs quickly watery but creamy, hydrates my skin and doesn't irritate my very sensitive combination skin. It has a neutral smell and it makes my skin silky and balanced. Already purchased a second one...
reviews.zh: 我超愛呢款化妝水！吸收好快，質地水潤但係又有少少奶霜感，保濕到皮膚，而且唔會刺激我好敏感嘅混合性皮膚。佢嘅味道中性，令皮膚滑溜、平衡。已經買咗第二支……

reviews.shade: Purito Seoul Oat PDRN Gentle Refining Toner 200ml
reviews.text: The best toner there is. It gives a lot of moisture. It soothes and helps calm redness in the skin. It smells a little unpleasant, but other than that, it's great.
reviews.zh: 最好嘅化妝水。保濕力好強。可以舒緩同幫助平復皮膚泛紅。味道有少少難聞，但係除咗呢點之外，都好好。

reviews.shade: Purito Seoul Oat PDRN Gentle Refining Toner 200ml
reviews.text: This feels moisturising and soothing but has an unpleasant smell but not enough enough to not make me want to use it
reviews.zh: 搽落感覺保濕同舒緩，不過有啲難聞嘅味道，但係唔夠到令我唔想用。

reviews.shade: Purito Seoul Oat PDRN Gentle Refining Toner 200ml
reviews.text: I like this toner but it's not nice or easy to use. It is pretty gentle, even when my skin is irritated I can use this without discomfort. It also has a gentle exfoliation and leaves my skin soft and smooth. However, if you use too much or try to layer it, the white residue doesn't absorb or go away. It leaves white streaks on your face or can even pill up (pictured). It can also make hyaluronic acid serums foam up when you use too much. I had never experienced my current Hyaluronic Acid serum foaming before, but it foamed after using this in either 2 things layers or 1 thick layer. I will use this up but wouldn't repurchase or recommend.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意呢款化妝水，但係用起嚟唔係好舒服，亦唔係好易用。佢都幾溫和，就算皮膚發炎嗰陣，我用都冇咩不適。佢仲有少少溫和去角效果，令皮膚柔軟光滑。不過，如果你用太多，或者試圖疊用，白色殘留物就唔會被吸收，亦唔會消失。佢會喺面上留低白色條紋，甚至會搓泥（見圖）。如果用太多，佢仲會令玻尿酸精華起泡。我以前用緊嘅玻尿酸精華從來冇起過泡，但係用咗呢款之後，無論係兩層薄塗定一層厚塗，都起咗泡。我會用晒佢，但唔會再買，亦唔會推薦。
